english_text: Mr President , the President of the Council , Mr Verhofstadt , stated in his presentation that in Laeken there were no taboos whatsoever . However , it is crystal clear that the stateless-nations-taboo is more present today than ever before . But as Victor Hugo said , `` nothing is more powerful than an idea whose time has come '' . Right now , the idea of self-determination is present in the Basque people ' s mind . More importantly , there is no reason for their disappearance unless we condemn them to such a fate . As a matter of fact , their disappearance would be not only a loss to humanity but the demolition of the best basis for the political future of Europe .
